summary: Iteration 84 — Hire @devmanager gating end-to-end (config endpoint, hire_prompt card + throttle, demo-bypass provisioning, dev-project /talk + builders 402 gates, DevStudio locked/hired UI, App Builder wizard, Templates panel locked/hired variants, Slash Popover). Backend: 13/13 pytest PASSED in ~10s (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration84_hire_gates.py). Frontend Playwright: HirePromptCard, Slash popover (all 7 options, filter, escape, keyboard nav, insertion), Mention popover intact, DevStudio unhired locks (ds-builders-lock, ds-hire-banner, 3x 'Hire @devmanager · $199' toolbar buttons), Templates locked (17 templates, 'Hire to use' disabled, templates-locked-banner), builders-locked panel on appbuilder+data nav, DevStudio hired unlocked (no lock, no banner, app-builder-panel is default, ab-input-purpose/users/features/style + ab-next/ab-build wizard, Templates 'Use this template' enabled, no locked banner). Login pattern: POST /api/auth/login {amit@demo.team, Demo@2026} which sets tn_session cookie in browser context — then hard-navigate to target URL. Direct-URL navigation avoids the credit-splash overlay intercepting chat clicks that plagued iter83.

ui_bugs.issue: Toolbar 'Hire @devmanager · $199' button still renders when project is already hired. DevStudio.jsx:368-370 renders <HireDevTeamButton chatId={project.related_chat_id} variant='toolbar' /> unconditionally — no `hired` guard. On a hired project this button is a dead-end: clicking it calls POST /chats/{id}/hire-dev-team/checkout which returns 400 'AI dev team is already hired for this chat'. Confirmed in browser screenshot on TEST_iter84_UI_hired · Project. Not blocking (rest of gating works), but confusing UX.

issues: CreditSplash (300/300 credits low balance) + 'Have you met AI CMO?' bottom-right upsell continue to intercept clicks on the chat list — automated tests worked around this by (a) direct-URL navigation to the target chat/studio and (b) DOM.remove() of the splash. Not a new issue; carried from iter83.

action_items: LOW UX: Hide (or replace with 'Hired ✓') the DevStudio top-toolbar HireDevTeamButton when `project.dev_team_hired === true`. Fix: `{!hired && project.related_chat_id && <HireDevTeamButton variant='toolbar' ... />}` at DevStudio.jsx:368.

NONE for iter84 scope — all backend gates and frontend flows tested pass. HirePromptCard, throttling, demo-bypass, project 402→200, App Builder wizard, Templates locked/hired variants, and Slash Popover all verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/chats.py:817 HIRE_DEV_TEAM_PRICE_USD read once at import time from env — good, but if the env changes it requires a restart. Acceptable for a launch-price flag.

services/dev_chat_agents.py:406-441 _post_hire_prompt uses a 2-minute throttle by looking up last message with metadata.hire_prompt — this is correct and race-free enough for chat velocity. Reads sender_id='ai-agent-devmgr' so a user-role filter isn't strictly needed since only the bot posts hire_prompt cards.

routes/dev_os_builders.py generate_builder_spec (line 191-255): Pydantic validation runs BEFORE _require_hired, so an unhired /generate call with missing `text` returns 422 not 402. This is arguably a leak-order issue (payload validation reveals endpoint shape to unauthorized users), but it does NOT bypass the gate — a valid payload still returns 402. Non-blocking, but worth noting for security-conscious code review.
DevStudio.jsx:368: HireDevTeamButton in toolbar variant lacks `!hired` guard — same as flagged in ui_bugs above.
DevStudio.jsx:308 ds-hire-banner is correctly gated by `!hired && project.related_chat_id` — consistent pattern.

HireDevTeamButton.jsx:56 window.location.reload() after demo-bypass provisioning is a heavy hammer; a lighter refresh (mutate SWR key or project store) would be smoother, but reload is acceptable for a one-time hire.

SlashCommandPopover.jsx:72 attaches window keydown listener with capture=true — coexists cleanly with the @ mention popover since only one popover is active at a time (detect() gates on caret at start of draft with /^\s*\//).

AppBuilderPanel.jsx 4-step wizard: all data-testids present (ab-input-{purpose,users,features,style}, ab-next, ab-back, ab-build, ab-preview, ab-add-feature). Step gating verified in UI (ab-next enabled after purpose filled).
TemplatesPanel.jsx: template-use-{id} button toggles disabled + text ('Hire to use' vs 'Use this template') on the `locked` prop — clean binary state. Verified 17 templates render in both states.

BuildersHub.jsx:401 `showLock = locked && b.key !== 'templates'` — correctly keeps templates rail item unlocked. Default active is 'templates' when locked, 'appbuilder' when hired — verified via app-builder-panel visible on hired project's first render.
